race.title: All-Weather Championships Season XIV River Eden EBF Fillies' Stakes (Listed) (GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: LIKEALOT and Morrophore stand out on their best form, with the former preferred having shown it more recently. Unexposed 3-y-o Yamnah is the potential fly in the ointment. LIKEALOT MORROPHORE (FR) YAMNAH (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Morrophore (11/8), Likealot (11/4), Little Dorrit (11/2), Littlecote (11/1), Yamnah (12/1), Pierian (14/1), Golden Muse (18/1), Light Of Paris (28/1), Charmaine (33/1), Cabrera (50/1), Dojin (50/1), Miss Wong (50/1), Gone By (66/1), Pinatique (66/1)
